name: Chen's Empty Keg
label: Quest
description: Following the creation of the potent Stormstout, Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet offers to craft another esoteric recipe learned from the elusive pandaren…
intro: Following the creation of the potent Stormstout, Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet offers to craft another esoteric recipe learned from the elusive pandaren wanderer Chen Stormstout. This potent concoction, known as trogg ale, requires rare organs and glands harvested from the native beasts of the Barrens.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.
Bring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.
Like I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You working hard at finding those ingredients, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha! I knew you couldn't resist some of this brew. Come back again anytime you want some more, friend. Just bring me more of the ingredients I had you collect.
